plugin.name: Grand Theft Auto 2 Widescreen Fix
MAIN.ResX.description: Output size in pixels; 0 selects the desktop size for this axis. Restart after editing through the hub.
MAIN.ResY.description: Output size in pixels; 0 selects the desktop size for this axis. Restart after editing through the hub.
MAIN.WindowMode.description: Fullscreen is the game's exclusive mode, which changes the display mode. Borderless is a window of the resolution's size without a frame, centred on the monitor; at the desktop's size it covers the screen. Restart required.
MAIN.FillFrontendBackground.description: Fills the screen with the menu backgrounds, cutting their top and bottom, instead of black bars at the sides.
MAIN.FMVWidescreenMode.description: How the movies fit the screen: at their original aspect ratio with black bars, filling the screen at their aspect ratio (the edges are cut), or stretched.
MAIN.HudAspectRatioConstraint.descriptio: Keeps the HUD in a centred box of this aspect ratio, such as 16:9 on wider screens: its elements stay at the box's sides. 4:3 keeps the original layout in the middle; Auto uses the whole screen.
MAIN.SkipIntro.description: Starts without the intro movie. Restart required.
MISC.SkipCredits.description: Quitting the game skips the credits.
MISC.NoSampManDelay.description: Removes a wait of the game's sound sample manager. Restart required.
MISC.QuicksaveKey.description: Windows virtual-key code; 0 disables this binding.
MISC.ZoomIncreaseKey.description: Windows virtual-key code; 0 disables this binding.
MISC.ZoomDecreaseKey.description: Windows virtual-key code; 0 disables this binding.
MISC.RecoverPlayerKey.description: Windows virtual-key code; 0 disables this binding.
CAMERA.RotateWithPlayer.description: The view turns so that the player's vehicle faces the top of the screen.
CAMERA.RotateInVehicles.description: The view turns with the vehicle the player drives.
CAMERA.RotateOnFoot.description: The view turns with the player on foot.
CAMERA.RotationSmoothing.description: Seconds the view takes to catch up with a turn.
CAMERA.ToggleRotationKey.description: Windows virtual-key code; 0 disables this binding.
CAMERA.SmoothFollow.description: The camera follows the player smoothly.
CAMERA.FollowTime.description: Seconds the smooth camera takes to catch up with the player.
CAMERA.HeightTime.description: Seconds the camera takes to change its height with the player's speed.
CAMERA.MaxLookAhead.description: How far the camera looks ahead of a fast vehicle.
MAIN.FOVFactor.description: Multiply the gameplay view range; larger values show more of the world.
INPUT.ModernControls.description: Uses the modern key bindings of the Controls page instead of the game's classic controls.
INPUT.StickThrottle.description: The stick's distance from the centre sets the vehicle's throttle.
INPUT.StickDeadzone.description: Part of the stick's movement around the centre that is ignored.
INPUT.MouseAim.description: The player aims at the mouse cursor while standing.
INPUT.MoveUpKey.description: Windows virtual-key code; 0 disables this binding.
INPUT.MoveDownKey.description: Windows virtual-key code; 0 disables this binding.
INPUT.MoveLeftKey.description: Windows virtual-key code; 0 disables this binding.
INPUT.MoveRightKey.description: Windows virtual-key code; 0 disables this binding.
INPUT.FireKey.description: Windows virtual-key code; 0 disables this binding.

INPUT.JumpKey.description: Windows virtual-key code; 0 disables this binding.

INPUT.PreviousWeaponKey.description: Windows virtual-key code; 0 disables this binding.
INPUT.NextWeaponKey.description: Windows virtual-key code; 0 disables this binding.
INPUT.PauseKey.description: Windows virtual-key code; 0 disables this binding.
DIAGNOSTICS.Enabled.description: Changes from the hub require a restart. Existing in-game options still apply changes immediately where supported.
